<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="20" y="19" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="323" y1="17" x2="323" y2="12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="328" y1="17" x2="328" y2="10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="333" y1="17" x2="333" y2="8" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="345" cy="13" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="348" y1="16" x2="351" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="359" y="8" width="22" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="361" y="10" width="16" height="7" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="382" y="11" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- App header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="59" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="29,58 21,66 29,74" fill="none" stroke="#4B4B4C" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="22" y1="66" x2="39" y2="66" stroke="#4B4B4C" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="67" y="61" width="256" height="10" rx="5" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <rect x="67" y="61" width="92" height="10" rx="5" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <circle cx="347" cy="66" r="14" fill="#DDF4FF" stroke="#63C9F9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="347" y="71" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#1899D6">2</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Intro panel -->
  <g>
    <rect x="17" y="100" width="356" height="142" rx="14" fill="#15451F" opacity="0.12"/>
    <rect x="17" y="98" width="356" height="142" rx="14" fill="#15451F"/>
    <circle cx="67" cy="138" r="26" fill="#FFC800"/>
    <polygon points="56,143 67,120 78,143" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="61" y="139" width="12" height="12" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="67" cy="130" r="3" fill="#15451F"/>
    <text x="111" y="132" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Let's do it!</text>
    <text x="38" y="176" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Tell us about your upcoming trip.</text>
    <text x="38" y="200" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">We'll tailor your French lessons for it.</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="246" y="211" width="105" height="36" rx="13" fill="#FFC800"/>
      <text x="298" y="234" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Let's Do It</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Question heading -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="281" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Where are you headed?</text>
    <text x="20" y="307" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Choose a destination to get useful travel words.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- French language card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="19" y="326" width="352" height="82" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="19" y="324" width="352" height="82" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="35" y="338" width="61" height="48" rx="11" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <rect x="35" y="338" width="20" height="48" rx="11" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <rect x="76" y="338" width="20" height="48" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="113" y="352" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">LEARNING</text>
    <text x="113" y="378" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">French</text>
    <circle cx="342" cy="365" r="13" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <polyline points="335,365 340,370 349,359" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Destination field -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="440" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Destination</text>
    <rect x="19" y="451" width="352" height="56" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="477" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="51" y1="483" x2="57" y2="489" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="70" y="483" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">e.g. Paris, Lyon, or Nice</text>
    <text x="20" y="530" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">You can change this later in your settings.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Trip timing cards -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="577" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">When are you going?</text>
    <rect x="19" y="591" width="168" height="58" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#00A47D" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="620" r="10" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="620" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="66" y="617" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">In 1–3 months</text>
    <text x="66" y="637" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Great timing</text>
    <rect x="203" y="591" width="168" height="58" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="229" cy="620" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="250" y="617" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Later this year</text>
    <text x="250" y="637" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Build your base</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Continue button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="678" width="350" height="48" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <text x="195" y="708" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Continue</text>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="753" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">STEP 2 OF 4</text>
  <circle cx="165" cy="769" r="4" fill="#00A47D"/>
  <circle cx="178" cy="769" r="4" fill="#00A47D"/>
  <circle cx="191" cy="769" r="4" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  <circle cx="204" cy="769" r="4" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  <line x1="20" y1="788" x2="370" y2="788" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="789" width="390" height="55" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <g>
      <rect x="24" y="795" width="58" height="30" rx="8" fill="#DDF4FF" stroke="#63C9F9" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="39,808 48,800 57,808" fill="none" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="42" y="807" width="12" height="10" fill="none" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="53" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#1899D6">Learn</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="139" cy="809" r="13" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="139,799 142,806 150,807 144,812 146,819 139,815 132,819 134,812 128,807 136,806" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="139" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Practice</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="250" cy="805" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="250" cy="818" rx="12" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="250" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Profile</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="350" cy="809" r="3" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <circle cx="361" cy="809" r="3" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <circle cx="372" cy="809" r="3" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <text x="361" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">More</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
